serverInfo.name: texuli
serverInfo.title: Texuli MCP Server
serverInfo.description: Every Texuli operation as an MCP tool: search the component catalog, read manifests and examples, validate manifests and blueprints, search, read and preview themes, and run deck and document commands. Local over stdio (npx -y @texuli/mcp, the edge and node operations) or remote over Streamable HTTP (https://texuli.com/mcp, the edge operations plus the site operations that list, read and search texuli.com's pages as Markdown). Read-only: nothing is stored, fetched from the network or modified.

tools.name: catalog.search
tools.title: Search the component catalog
tools.description: Search the built, content-addressed Texuli component catalog by text, group and emit tier. Returns the catalog hash and file name, the match count and one summary per component (id, package, label, summary, tier, group, emit tiers).

tools.name: catalog.validate
tools.title: Validate catalog manifests
tools.description: Validate one candidate catalog manifest, or a set (which also catches duplicate ids), without writing files. Returns valid and a list of diagnostics, each with a code, a JSONPath, a message and a hint.

tools.name: component.get
tools.title: Read a component manifest
tools.description: Read one component manifest from the catalog by id. Returns { component }: its props with kinds and schemas, events, worked examples, useWhen and dontUseWhen guidance, accessibility notes and the emit tiers that may place it (an empty emit list means agent output may not).

tools.name: example.search
tools.title: Find component examples
tools.description: Find worked manifest examples (props an agent can copy) by component id and/or example id, or search their titles and descriptions. Returns the match count and each example with its component id and package.

tools.name: blueprint.validate
tools.title: Validate a blueprint draft
tools.description: Validate a blueprint draft (a catalog tree, an array of trees, or a texuli-blueprint envelope, migrated first) with the catalog's checks: structure, sinks, tree limits, component ids, tiers, prop, block and document schemas, the envelope's designSystem (codes under $.designSystem), grammar and the frame root. Returns valid, status, tier, migratedFrom and diagnostics with stable codes.

tools.name: blueprint.theme
tools.title: Apply a design system to a blueprint
tools.description: Set a blueprint envelope's designSystem to a reference ({ ref: "acme@2.1.0" } or a library theme "texuli:ocean") or an inline document, wrapping a bare tree in a draft envelope first, then validate the result as blueprint.validate does; an inline document is also compiled for the contrast, focus and target guarantees. Returns valid, the themed blueprint and diagnostics with stable codes.

tools.name: block.list
tools.title: List block types
tools.description: List the content block types the blocks-* components render (table, stat, cta, poll …), optionally for one component or matching words. Returns the match count and, per type, the component that renders it, a label and when to use it; read one shape with block.schema.

tools.name: block.schema
tools.title: Read a block shape
tools.description: Read the shape of one content block type: the component that renders it, its fields as compact text and as a JSON Schema (required fields are the ones the validator refuses a block without), examples that validate in a blueprint, limits, when to use it and whether it can pass blueprint.validate today. Returns what a blocks-* node’s block prop needs.

tools.name: theme.search
tools.title: Search the theme library
tools.description: Search the Texuli theme library (200+ offline themes) by words, category, collection, mood or tag. Returns the match count and each theme’s metadata: id, name, description, category, collection, mood, tags, contrast level and whether it is dark-first.

tools.name: theme.get
tools.title: Read a full theme
tools.description: Read the full token definition of one library theme by id. Returns { theme }: its id, name, description and every light and dark color, radius, font and chart token, ready to compile or apply.

tools.name: theme.preview
tools.title: Preview a theme
tools.description: Preview one library theme in light or dark mode. Returns its summary, the key tokens of that mode (background, foreground, primary, border, radius, font …) and the WCAG 2.x AA contrast report for both modes (aa.pass and issue counts).

tools.name: ds.validate
tools.title: Validate a design system
tools.description: Validate a design-system document: the spec's closed schema, the extends chain, then a compile of the document and its high-contrast variant with the guarantees enforced (text contrast, focus ring, target size). Returns valid, the distinct codes, every error with its JSON path and hint, the compiler warnings and the hash.

tools.name: ds.compile
tools.title: Compile a design system
tools.description: Compile a design-system document to concrete --tx-* variables per mode and emit one format: compiled JSON, scoped CSS, a Tailwind preset, DTCG or Tokens Studio. Returns valid, the format, its media type, the content as text, the hash and warnings; a refused document returns errors with stable codes instead.

tools.name: ds.contrast
tools.title: Report design-system contrast
tools.description: Compile a design-system document and report every contrast pair the guarantees check, per mode: foreground and background roles, kind (text, ui, focus), ratio, requirement and pass, plus the solver adjustments. Returns valid, the target (AA or AAA), targetMin and the per-mode pairs, or errors with stable codes.

tools.name: ds.suggest
tools.title: Suggest a design system
tools.description: Suggest a starting design-system document from one seed color, up to three brand colors (seed, secondary, accent) or a logo as RGBA pixels (the dominant colors pick the seed). Returns valid, the document, the dominant palette for pixels, the key tokens of each mode and warnings.

tools.name: ds.import
tools.title: Import a design system
tools.description: Turn what a team already has into a valid design-system document: a brand one-liner ("brand #4f46e5, font Inter, rounded, compact"), a W3C DTCG file, a Tokens Studio file, a flat role palette or a Texuli theme (an object, or a library theme id). Returns valid, the document and warnings for every value it dropped, or errors with stable codes.

tools.name: ds.diff
tools.title: Diff two design systems
tools.description: Compile two design-system documents (before is the baseline) and compare them: every added, removed or changed --tx-* variable per mode, contrast pairs that regressed below the target, changed component defaults and attributes. Returns valid, identical, the summary counts and each list, or errors tagged with their side.

tools.name: ds.preview
tools.title: Preview a design system
tools.description: Render a static, deterministic snapshot of a compiled design system: svg (swatches, a button and a card per mode) or html (the review report: swatches, type ramp, component sheet, contrast table and adjustments). Fixed fonts, no time, no scripts; every value escaped. Returns valid, the format, media type, content and hash.

tools.name: ds.save
tools.title: Save a design system to a file
tools.description: Validate a design-system document (as ds.validate does) and write it as two-space JSON to the explicit .json path you pass, inside the working directory: traversal, symlinks, dot directories and dotfiles, node_modules, package.json and an existing file without overwrite are refused. Local doors only. Returns saved, the relative path and bytes written, or errors with stable codes.

tools.name: deck.run
tools.title: Run a deck command
tools.description: Inspect, lint and convert a Texuli deck on the shared v2 model: capabilities, the JSON Schema, layouts, lint, inspect, from-markdown and to-markdown. Pure compute; returns { result } with the command output (ok, issues, deck, markdown …).

tools.name: document.run
tools.title: Run a document command
tools.description: Create, validate, inspect, patch and convert a Texuli document (spec 0.7.0): capabilities, the JSON Schema, validate, inspect, a bounded RFC 6902 patch (at most 1000 operations), from-markdown, to-markdown and to-blueprint. Returns { result } with the command output; PDF and DOCX are document.export.

tools.name: document.export
tools.title: Export a document as PDF or DOCX
tools.description: Write a Texuli document as PDF or DOCX bytes with the owned writers, links and media checked at the tier. Returns { result } with ok, mime, byteLength, base64 bytes (no files are written), diagnostics and, for PDF, pageCount. Needs Node.

tools.name: site.pages
tools.title: List texuli.com pages
tools.description: List the pages of texuli.com from its Markdown twin manifest, in path order, optionally under a path prefix, a page at a time. Returns the total, the offset, the next offset when more follow, and each page’s path, twin path, URL, title and description.

tools.name: site.read
tools.title: Read a texuli.com page as Markdown
tools.description: Read one texuli.com page as its Markdown twin: the page’s own content with a header block (title, description, canonical URL, last updated). Accepts a route, its .md twin path or a texuli.com URL. Returns the path, twin, URL, title, the Markdown, its size and whether it was cut at the size cap.

tools.name: site.search
tools.title: Search texuli.com pages
tools.description: Search texuli.com pages by words in their titles, headings, descriptions and paths, ranked deterministically (more matched words first, then title over path over heading over description). Returns the total and, per hit, the path, twin, URL, title, description, score and up to three matching headings.
